_about: Hosts that are not an issuing authority and have surfaced non-document images (flags, buildings, press photos, vendor marketing) in the specimen-acquisition loop's automated screen (tools/screen_candidates.py). Parallel in shape to legal_portals.json: one domain per entry, keys starting with `_` are documentation. A candidate whose image_url or page_url host, or a subdomain of it, matches an entry here is auto-rejected with reason "denylisted-host" before any fetch -- the same mechanism DENYLISTED_HOSTS uses for PRADO, kept in its own file because this list grows from screener findings rather than SPECIMEN_SOURCES.md's fixed "Never a source" set. Add a host here when a cycle's screener report names it, with the one-line reason from that report.
guineaecuatorialpress.com: press agency, not an issuing authority -- surfaced non-document photos in cycle c13's screener report
digitalinvea.com: third-party vendor site (footer: "Powered by Viditure Inc."), not an issuing authority -- surfaced non-document photos in cycle c13's screener report
